$comment: Aureline, the streets. Ambient only. Nobody in this file is a member of the cast -- Lyra, Tarin, Cassian and the commander belong to whoever writes the Act 4 events, and a second Lyra standing on the pavement outside the headquarters would be the join nobody owns. What is here is the other hundred and sixty thousand people. Three notes on the tone, all from CANON.md. FIRST, the Meridian Foundation is publicly LOVED here, and most of the people who work for it are doing genuinely good work and have no idea what is inside it -- so nobody warns the player, and the one or two who are uneasy are uneasy about paperwork, not about a conspiracy. SECOND, this is a capital: strangers, cost of living, transport, weather, and everybody in a hurry. THIRD, foreign regions and other leagues come up in the ordinary way, because Averra is much bigger than this game. Everything is one to three sentences. Add entries here rather than replacing the file: the exterior crowd and the story beats have to share it.
